ns2:section.sectionText: Addresses transnational trends in blockbuster cinema relating to the influence of other media such as video games, social networking, and personal electronics. Considers impact of technology such as digital capture, computer generated imagery and other special effects technologies, as well as the economic structures of global filmmaking production, exhibition, and promotion. Queries taste categories across popular and art cinemas, and also explores the transformations of long-standing spectatorship categories such as 3-D, the teen film, queer cinema, the woman's film, and the documentary. Films screened will (likely) include "Avatar", "Antichrist", "Miami Vice", "Cloverfield", "Mysterious Skin", "Twilight", "Exit Through the Gift Shop", and "The Social Network".
